fields.name: item
fields.description: what this row records: purpose_<id> for a purpose (purpose_info, purpose_booking, purpose_my_booking, purpose_change, purpose_other), else the id of a checklist item the step notice names

fields.name: words
fields.description: what the customer said, close to their words (for a purpose: what they asked; for an item with choices or a form: the value in that form)

fields.name: style
fields.description: only on the style row: the menu names the customer chose, one per service, comma separated, exactly as the step notice lists them; recommend when the customer does not know and wants a suggestion

fields.name: state
fields.description: only on a purpose row: open while it is being handled, done when it is finished
